segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Oh hello, I'd like to join the video library. MR MAX OK. Would you like to fill in the application form now?

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Yes, I can do it now. MR MAX Hold on and I'll get a form. Now, I'll just ask you a few questions and then I'll get you to sign at the bottom.

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Right. MR MAX What's your full name?

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Louise Cynthia Jones. MR MAX Jones?

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Yes, that's right. MR MAX OK, and what's your address?

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Apartment 1, 72 Black Street, Highbridge. MR MAX Black Street, that's just around the corner, isn't it?

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Yes. MR MAX OK, so the post code is 2085, right?

segments.speaker: MR MAX
segments.en: Mm. And your telephone number? I need both home and work.

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Home is 9835 6712 and work is 9456 1309. Do you need any ID or anything like that? MR MAX Yes, we need your driver's licence number, that is if you have one.

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Yes, 1 know if off by heart, it's an easy one, 2020BD. Do you need to see it?

segments.speaker: MR MAX
segments.en: Yes, I'm afraid I do.

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Mm . . . here.

segments.speaker: MR MAX
segments.en: Right, thanks. And could you tell me your date of birth please?

segments.speaker: MR MAX
segments.en: That's the most important part out of the way, but could I just ask you a few questions for a survey we're conducting?

segments.speaker: O K .
segments.en: MR MAX What kind of videos do you prefer to watch? Have a look at this list.

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Well, I love anything that makes me laugh. I just love to hear jokes and funny punch lines. I'm not very keen on westerns, although my father likes them, but I'm a real softie, so anything with a bit of a love story is good for me. It doesn't matter how old. Not musicals though, they're too much! MR MAX Anything else?

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: I'm completely taken by documentaries of the great outdoors, you know the sort, animals, plants and far away places. 1 saw a wonderful one on dolphins last week. It was amazing.

segments.speaker: MR MAX
segments.en: Now, I think that's all from me, except I need you to sign here on the line. Here's a pen. Oh, and I nearly forgot, the membership fee. $25, refundable if you leave the library for any reason.

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: There you are. And do I sign here?

segments.speaker: MR MAX
segments.en: Yes, that's it. You can borrow videos now, if you like, but your card won't be ready until next week. You can come and pick it up when you bring your first videos back. That is if you want to take some now.

segments.speaker: LOUISE
segments.en: Yes, I'd like to. I'll have a look around. MR MAX Fine.
